people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.
translations.bsb: “Am I a dog,” he said to David, “that you come at me with sticks?” And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
translations.kjv: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
translations.asv: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
